get.description: Groups Acumatica customer accounts into effective pricing tiers for downstream wholesale-vs-retail mapping
Fetches live orders from Acumatica ERP and overlays local warehouse/delivery workflow status when available
Fetches order detail including line items from Acumatica ERP and overlays local warehouse/delivery workflow status when available
Fetches Acumatica customers and derives effective pricing tiers for downstream feeds

DistributionPriceTierListResponse.description: Grouped distribution pricing tiers derived from Acumatica customer accounts

DistributionPriceTierResponse.description: Single effective pricing tier with all attached customer accounts

OrderListResponse.description: Paginated list of sales orders from Acumatica ERP

OrderSummaryResponse.description: Summary view of a single sales order

OrderWorkflowStatusResponse.description: Internal YourMix warehouse and delivery workflow state overlaid on top of an Acumatica sales order

OrderDetailResponse.description: Full details of a single sales order including line items

OrderLineItemResponse.description: Line item within a sales order

DistributionCustomerListResponse.description: Distribution customer pricing accounts derived from Acumatica customers

DistributionCustomerPricingAccountRespon.description: Distribution customer account with effective pricing tier derived from Acumatica fields

CatalogIdentityProjectionResponse.description: Explicit backend-owned catalog identity row based on the current provisional SKU join rule

CatalogIdentityProjectionSummaryResponse.description: Summary of the current backend-owned catalog identity projection built from the provisional SKU join rule
